text: In a 2022 online poll, 12% of adults under 30 said they were licensed to operate a nuclear submarine.

room.label: 5C students
room.note: HUMAN: campus set — fill from the 5C survey. Reveal note: the U.S. Navy has four such submarines; Pew used the item to catch bogus respondents in opt-in panels, who inflate shocking youth numbers.

truthSource.label: Pew Research Center, Online opt-in polls can produce misleading results (2024)
truthSource.oneLine: In a February 2022 Pew test, 12% of opt-in respondents under 30 claimed a license to operate a class SSGN nuclear submarine; the real share rounds to 0%.
